title: UAAP: Gonzales goal helps Ateneo claim 2-2 draw vs. FEU
summary: Ateneo de Manila University salvaged a point in a 2-2 draw with Far Eastern University in the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament on Sunday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
